notes:
- Business: Subscribeo builds subscription billing and customer success workflows for mid-market SaaS (Stripe + Zuora integrations).
- Primary project: embed chat-based billing assistant for CS + self-serve dispute resolution.
- What they liked: Redwood streaming + function/tool calling => deterministic JSON outputs to call Stripe/Zuora APIs, easy mapping to existing webhook flows.
- POC specifics: using hosted API, streaming enabled; test flows: refund requests, invoice lookups, plan change authorizations.
- Latency: customer requires p95 < = 200ms for small lookups (customer profile + invoice fetch). Current hosted POC shows p95 ~220ms under baseline single-region load; streaming reduces RTT perception but backend still needs p95 headroom.
- Throughput: expected steady-state 80-140 reqs/sec during business hours, spiky peaks to 400r/s (billing windows). Cost sensitivity high — want cost model for hosted vs Dedicated (committed pool).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS integration for keys, long-lived audit logs, EU data residency for EMEA customers. SOC2 attestation required before procurement.
- Integration: primary integrations to Stripe (charge/refund, disputes) and Zuora (ledger, invoices); needs structured outputs (JSON schema) from model for safe function calling. Also wants redaction rules on PII before log retention.
- Commercial: interested in 12mo committed Dedicated if pricing meets unit economics; otherwise continue on hosted with cost controls (batching, caching).
- Quotes from call: "We need to be able to hand this to CS reps with confidence — latency and deterministic JSON are non-negotiable."
- Action items: SE (Priya) to run dedicated throughput bench on similar model, produce p95/p99 analysis; AE (Jordan) to provide committed-tier pricing scenarios and demo Dedicated fallback flow; Legal to receive SOC2 pack and data residency language; send sample webhook mapping for tool-calling JSON schema.
- Quick wins suggested: enable prefix KV caching for invoice lookups; tune batching for background analytics to reduce token spend.
